title: Swedish Political Observatory
question: What do politicians say, propose and vote for?
description: A shared entry point to formal parliamentary records. I started this because the connection between political language, budget priorities and recorded decisions is difficult to follow.

title: Swedish Job Market Analytics
question: How has the market for data and software roles changed?
description: Historical job-ad aggregates, role definitions and technology mentions, with clear denominators and downloadable data.

title: DrugComb Synergy Prediction
question: How well does a model generalise to unseen drug pairs?
description: Drug and cell-line entity resolution, a DuckDB warehouse and model evaluation under four cross-validation strategies. Explore the exported results and their assumptions.

title: Allegoria / RFC Drift
question: What changes when a requirement goes from MUST to SHOULD?
description: A structured meaning-quality engine explored through RFC requirement profiles and clearly labelled synthetic examples. Validated political direction scoring is not available.

title: Incident NLP · Degree project
question: Can similar incidents reveal useful review candidates?
description: A privacy-aware Databricks workflow combining selected ISO/IEC 25012 data-quality dimensions, embeddings and clustering. Only approved aggregate results are shown.

title: Homie API
question: How can household activity become understandable analytics?
description: A FastAPI and PostgreSQL project with authentication, immutable completion-event design and aggregation SQL. Household, task and analytics endpoints remain documented stubs.
